'''Alpha Squad''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was guarding [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]]'s base, the [[Kalarath Imperial Encampment]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] along with [[Beta Squad]], [[Delta Squad (Tatooine)|Delta Squad]] and [[Gamma Squad (Tatooine)|Gamma Squad]]. When the [[Havoc Squad]] showed up to extract [[Vanto Bazren]] and stop Gorik's operation, it was engaged by Delta Squad, while Alpha, Beta and Delta evacuated along with the Colonel.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alpha Squad is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission "Evacuation" on Tatooine only if the player takes the dark side option to pursue Gorik and leave Bazren to die.<ref name="SWTOR" />
